run_tldr: TLDR: H5-A1 compares attempt memory plus a release-at-4 reserve with attempt memory and bounded always-check. Six authored process streams, three policies and four epochs yield72dependent decisions under two checks and two calls per trajectory. Score all assigned actions, urgent delay, late recovery and resource use. Known timing, scripted votes and one domain limit generalization.
